item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:45 HKT 11/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of southern China will be gradually replaced by a warm and humid maritime airstream over the weekend. It will be foggy over the region early next week. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong on Tuesday morning. It will become appreciably cooler and windier over the region. Under the influence of the associated relatively dry continental airstream, the weather over southern China will improve in the middle and latter parts of next week.
